title: DBD LCHILD statement naming a logical child segment in another database, after the SEGM and FIELD it belongs to
shapes: HKEP HKEPDB2: LCHILD NAME=(ENTRY,HKEPDB3) between FIELD KEEPKEY and SEGM WALL
asserts: HKEPDB2 keys one LCHILD fact (name ENTRY, dbname HKEPDB3, segment KEEP: the SEGM it follows).

citations.quote: LCHILD statements immediately follow the SEGM, FIELD, or XDFLD statement of the segment involved in the relationship.
The dbname parameter is the name of the database that contains the segment type specified in segname1.

notes: HKEPDB3 is not in the estate: the LCHILD names a database outside it, as the page allows. POINTER= and PAIR= are not coded; the key asserts neither.
